events.outcome: MTS support updated in 2026 confirms the Сохраняю номер service exists for eligible no-monthly-fee tariffs and that most lines face termination after roughly six months without qualifying top-up or spend. The product-price page remains geo-fragile, so tariff eligibility should stay constrained.
RUB349/6 months, initial immediate debit and renewal from sufficient balance on eligible tariffs; this is not an acquisition price.

Ordinary no-monthly-fee inactivity is distinct from subscribed number-retention. MTS says 30 inactive days may trigger RUB1.5/day until available balance runs out, then possible contract termination after six months.
Foreign citizens need passport/Gosuslugi/biometrics in Russia. A new eSIM first activates only on Russia's own MTS network; offshore/China-first activation is not demonstrated.
MTS documents a conditional 24-hour SMS/data restriction after returning from abroad or >72 hours offline, with early lifting after device verification. It is not a universal overseas OTP rate.
An independent MTS user reported incoming roaming-SMS failure until roaming was enabled; this report is general MTS roaming and not tested on this retention add-on or a specific app.
Archived Номер навсегда RUB1,500 one-time may be a distinct historical product. Availability and scope are unverified; do not conflate with current Сохраняю номер RUB349/6 months.

data.acquisitionSummary: Сохраняю номер is an optional retention add-on for an existing eligible MTS Russia mobile line, not a new starter tariff. The selected tariff and all existing paid subscriptions remain separately chargeable; confirm eligibility in My MTS.

keep.action: Current MTS product terms charge RUB349 immediately for six months, then automatically renew for another six months only if sufficient account funds remain. The service extends the no-paid-use/no-top-up period; suitable for eligible individual plans without subscription/monthly charges or other paid services. Combined home internet and TV packages are excluded. Verify eligibility in My MTS.

data.chinaActivation: Foreign-citizen new SIMs require in-person Russian MTS identity registration, Gosuslugi and biometrics. A new MTS eSIM can first activate only on MTS's own Russian network, not in China or other roaming networks.
data.kyc: Foreign citizens need in-person MTS/passport onboarding, Gosuslugi confirmation, biometrics and registered device IMEI. Online new-eSIM purchase is limited to eligible Russian citizens.
data.payment: The six-month fee and renewal draw down adequate existing MTS account balance. App/website top-ups by supported bank card/SBP/SberPay are documented; reliable foreign-issued-card top-ups from abroad are unverified.
data.roamingSms: Current MTS roaming help confirms ordinary send/receive SMS on partner networks when suitable roaming facilities are enabled. Exact China bank/app OTP delivery for this add-on remains unverified. MTS imposes a 24-hour SMS/data security restriction on returning from abroad or after >72 hours offline, with an early verification flow. One older independent MTS roaming report of incoming SMS failure until roaming was enabled is generic, not exact add-on evidence.
data.refund: After non-use disconnection, MTS says number recovery may be possible only before reassignment; retaining a number does not remove KYC, roaming or anti-fraud SMS controls.
data.holdReason: Existing-line-only add-on; exact tariff eligibility, foreign registration, Russia-only first eSIM activation, offshore payment and exact China bank/app OTP are meaningful constraints.
data.tariffSummary: Сохраняю номер: current RUB349/6mo, approximately RUB698/12mo on eligible existing lines; funded automatic renewal required. The separate ordinary no-fee lifecycle may charge RUB1.5/day after 30 days without activity and terminate six months after the balance runs out. Archived Номер навсегда RUB1,500 one-time remains unverified as a current purchasable alternative.
